nodes.name: When another workflow crashes
nodes.notes: The last-resort net. Set this workflow as the Error Workflow on every other Clearwater workflow, and anything unexpected lands here instead of vanishing.

nodes.name: When a lead is quarantined
nodes.notes: Called on purpose by the pipeline when it knows a lead cannot go on: no email address, scoring failed, HubSpot refused. Carries the lead itself, which the crash path cannot.

nodes.name: Describe the failure
nodes.notes: Flattens both trigger shapes into the Quarantine tab's columns.

nodes.name: Write to the Quarantine tab
nodes.notes: Append only - a quarantined lead is a record, never overwritten. Columns are matched to the headers by name.

nodes.name: Alert the owner
nodes.notes: A quarantine alert always fires, whatever the tier. Silence here would mean a lost lead nobody knew about.
